basic_info.headline: Software Engineer Desiring to Heal the World
basic_info.about:
Highly skilled leader with extensive experience in software engineering for multiple industries, including Consumer gaming and U.S. Defense.  Passionate engineer who is results driven and possesses the ability to complete projects successfully on time.  Experience as CTO in a start-up company and Lead Programmer on long-term projects for gaming products.  Seasoned in multiple computer languages and development environments.  Possesses the ability to quickly learn new programming languages and new environments.  Graduated with honors in Electrical and Electronic Engineering.

Competencies:
Experienced in developing software for many platforms:
•	Android and iOS mobile devices
•	Nintendo Wii
•	Microsoft X-Box
•	Sony Playstation and Playstation 2
•	Sega Saturn
•	Aircraft flight computers/hardware (proprietary)
•	Flight computer test equipment (semi-proprietary)
Experienced in developing software under multiple environments such as Unreal Engine, Unity, proprietary (in-house RTOS) and commercial (i.e. MS Windows, Linux, SGI (IRIX) etc.) operating systems. 
Well versed in multiple computer languages: C/C++, C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python (and some antiques like Pascal, JOVIAL (J73)), and multiple assembly languages and scripting tools
Highly skilled in Object-Oriented-Design/Programming
Experienced with Maya (including plug-in/exporter development), Photoshop, and CAD software

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer/CTO
experience.description:
• Led the development of core technologies and gameplay systems for Sound System, a next-generation rhythm game.  
• Designed and implemented the majority of the user interface, enhancing player engagement and experience.  
• Established strategic plans for expanding the game into multiplayer and online platforms, ensuring future growth.  
• Mentored fellow engineers in Unity development, fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer
experience.description:
Client/tool/backend development for title (to become KingdomMaker under Global Worldwide, Inc.) using Unity and TypeScript/JavaScript​:
•	Algorithmic world generation tool
•	World data structure data definition
•	Client and server-side data access API’s
•	Client and server-side route planning system
•	Client world render creation
•	Supporting other team members
•	Guided client architecture from low-level systems to UI.
•	Development of data driven scripting system for game UI guidance – retrofitted into established/mature game system.
•	Monitoring of game performance and optimization.
•	Diagnosis of live game issues.

experience.title: Sr. Client Engineer
experience.description:
Client/tool/backend development for title (to become KingdomMaker under Global Worldwide, Inc.) using Unity and TypeScript/JavaScript.
Development of unreleased title for PC/Oculus(Meta) using Unreal Engine (UE3 & UE4):
•	Development of gameplay systems
•	Supporting other members of the team with technical guidance
•	Implementation of missing engine features on mobile platforms
•	Debugging engine operations
•	Development of vehicle physics using PhysX
•	Maintenance and update integration of the UE codebase

experience.title: Senior Programmer
experience.description: Contract technology development/incorporation for game industry clients.

experience.title: Lead Engineer/CTO
experience.description:
Managed company technology:  file servers, source management system, VPN, and workstations.
Lead development on Jerry Rice & Nitus' Dog Football and the beginnings of various follow-on projects.
•	Technical lead for development team, including:
•	    Defined and monitored the technical design of the game application
•	    Provided technical guidance to the engineers on my team
•	Game development, including:
•	    Development of tool scripts to assist artists with asset development
•	Development of tool scripts for level layout for game designers/artists
•	    Implementation of key lower-level systems within the game
•	    Application optimization for both execution speed and memory usage.
•	    Overall application debugging.
•	    Integration and debugging of middle ware solutions
•	Exploration of Nintendo 3DS and iPad development environments and performance.
•	Tested art asset pathway for each system, determining the modifications required to be performed by the artists.
•	Separation of the existing Dog Football game from the existing middle ware—developing our own internal platform-independent library API to replace low-level systems such as math and file access with minimal changes required to the game code.
•	Setup and administration of the company's technology assets, including:
•	    CentOS (Linux OS) server
•	    Perforce source management system
•	    VPN system solution (OpenVPN)
•	    Network configuration
•	    Windows XP and Windows 7 workstations
•	    Target platform development hardware
